Mirzapur: The Movie Earns ₹30 Crore on Opening Day

Mirzapur: The Movie, starring Pankaj Tripathi and Ali Fazal, achieved a gross opening day collection of ₹30 crore. The film's Hindi release contributed the majority of these earnings, with a smaller amount from its Telugu version. This debut places it among the top opening day grossers for Hindi films in 2026, surpassing expectations and setting new records. The movie's performance has been described as a 'bhaukal' (impactful) opening.
